== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Symbolic Celerity}}
* {{skill icon|Symbols of Inspiration}} ([[elite]])

== Notes ==
* Signet of Illusions has good synergy with spell copying skills (e.g. [[Inspired Hex]] or [[Arcane Thievery]]), since the copied skills will be used with a high effective rank.
* Spells with a [[fail]]ure chance below a certain attribute rank (such as [[Slippery Ground]]) used while under this skill's effect retain their chance to fail.
* Has no [[duration]] (this is one of the few [[Upkeep#Skills_that_last_indefinitely_without_an_upkeep|skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep]]).
* [[No Attribute]] spells still use charges.
* Although they are not technically linked to attributes, Signet of Illusions will work with spells linked to title tracks.
